_comment: Adversarial fixture for the `document` config surface (F3). Every field here is enum, clamped-number, or regex-validated-string shaped, so none of it may take the escapeLatex path — it must be rejected by BlueprintSchema outright, or, where a field never made the schema in the first place, must simply have no effect. See packages/core/test/sanitize.test.ts.
